decisions.reason: As an inertial measurement sensor module it is close to the firm's electronics and sensing knowledge base, and after only one year the firm is likely to keep it on the market to learn and improve it.
An industrial AC voltage input module fits very closely with established industrial electronics capabilities, and its own product page suggests enough commitment and market relevance to continue.
A four-channel solid state relay module is a natural adjacency to control and interface electronics, so the firm can absorb feedback and refine it using existing know-how.

A server room monitoring sensor kit looks more like a niche systems solution than a core module product, and with only light website presence it is the weakest fit with the firm's likely existing knowledge base.
